## Executive Summary
Lemi Gobena Jaleta is an Ethiopian software engineer specializing in scalable full-stack web platforms, mobile healthtech systems, and distributed backend architectures. He combines deep theoretical fundamentals in software engineering at Addis Ababa University with production commercial experience delivering real-world enterprise platforms at Mereb Technologies.
